WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
)
SELECT
  AVG(oa.avg_rebate) AS avg_of_order_avg_rebates,
  AVG(oa.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_of_order_avg_net_fee_rates,
  AVG(oa.avg_net_fee_rate - b.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE oa.avg_net_fee_rate > b.avg_net_fee_rate;
